texts.facts: He has filed this writ petition alleging that the entire activities of the unit are being obstructed by the party respondents. On that basis the petitioner seeks an order directing that police protection be given to him, so that the normal functioning of the unit could be carried on. On the basis of the direction given by this Court the learned Government Pleader has obtained instructions from the 4th respondent which show that the 8th respondent is the immediate neighbour of the petitioner. It is stated that on account of the discharge of untreated effluents from the petitioner's unit, the drinking water in the well of the 8th respondent got contaminated leading to illness to her children. It is stated that under such circumstances, the residents in the neighbourhood, are agitating against the petitioner's unit. 3. The learned Government Pleader has made available a copy of the certificate of examination of the well water drawn from the well in the residential premises of the 8th respondent which substantiates the submissions. It is also stated that the unit in question does not have any permission from the Kerala State Pollution Control Board.
